title: ReleaseManifest
description: What a running web surface is serving (GET /release.json, ADR-016). Open clients compare it on focus and reconnect; a client outside the supported window is prompted and reloads only when that is safe.

contracts_version.description: openvibe-contracts version the service runs against.

packages.description: Versions of the platform packages the page loads (openvibe-shared, openvibe-sdk, ...).

min_client_release.description: Oldest client release still supported; null while every client in the window is.
